shortDescription: Create or Update or Delete Layer3 Interface configuration on AOS-CX.

options.name: interface
options.description: Interface name, should be in the format chassis/slot/port, e.g. 1/2/3, 1/1/32.

options.name: interface_qos_rate
options.description:
The rate limit value configured for broadcast/multicast/unknown unicast traffic. Dictionary should have the format 'type_of_traffic': speed e.g.
  'unknown-unicast': 100pps
  'broadcast': 200pps
  'multicast': 200pps

options.name: interface_qos_schedule_profile
options.description: Attaching existing QoS schedule profile to interface. *This parameter is deprecated and will be removed in a future version.

options.name: ip_helper_address
options.description: Configure a remote DHCP server/relay IP address on the device interface. Here the helper address is same as the DHCP server address or another intermediate DHCP relay.

options.name: ipv4
options.description: The IPv4 address and subnet mask in the address/mask format. The first entry in the list is the primary IPv4, the remainings are secondary IPv4. To remove an IP address pass in the list and use the delete state.

options.name: ipv6
options.description: The IPv6 address and subnet mask in the address/mask format. It takes multiple IPv6 with comma separated in the list. To remove an IP address pass in the list and use the delete state.

options.name: state
options.description: Create, Update, or Delete Layer3 Interface

options.name: vrf
options.description: VRF to which the port belongs if the port is routing. If none provided, the interface will be in the Default VRF. If the VRF is removed or changed all configuration is erased from the interface.
